- The agent responses show consistent, concise communication with response lengths ranging from 44 to 106 characters
- Response complexity correlates with query complexity (the compound question about weather and time produced the longest response)
- All responses are appropriately detailed without being verbose
- The agent efficiently uses tool calls to provide accurate information
